server/research/commerce/durable-checkout-submission.ts: POST /api/research/checkout/durable on the canonical active-member guard. Effects in order: canonical gates via CheckoutService.evaluate (additive export; denials persist nothing) -> inventory hold -> canonical order saved checkout_pending -> execution intent (request digest, priced-cart fingerprint, order, holds, stable keys) -> ONLY THEN coordinator/provider. Same key+body => continues the same execution (executions.verifyRequest); changed details => idempotency_conflict; concurrent duplicates fold into the winner (own order cancelled, holds released); legacy settled order answers its truth; large-order review / zero-charge orders stay on the assisted path. Returns {requestKey, orderId, state, idempotent}; onCommitted hook for the canonical notifier (none exists for the commerce lane today — your call).
EXECUTED: 493/493 across 13 files incl. existing checkout/routes/production-deps/production-wiring suites; full tsc exit 0. Local only: real StripePaymentAdapter over the idempotency model + in-memory stores.
COMPOSITION (yours): registerDurableCheckoutApi + registerCheckoutContinuationApi + webhook executions processor, per the handoff recipe; then the checkout page posts to the durable door and mounts PaymentAuthenticationStep on authentication_required/uncertain states. Resolver stays Disabled until the staging rehearsal (candidate at c70b77e) and the connected Stripe test-mode journey pass.
NEXT from me: the checkout page wiring (client) unless you take it; say once.
